title: C14 TanStack Query

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: Search-as-you-type uses TanStack Query with request dedup and caching (keystrokes share/cancel in-flight queries; repeated queries hit cache) against a search Route Handler.
An infinite-scroll list uses useInfiniteQuery to page results and loads further pages on scroll without duplicating already-loaded items.

A server-prefetched query is dehydrated and passed through a HydrationBoundary so the first paint matches the client with no hydration mismatch warnings in the console (QA functional: TanStack Query hydration boundary produces no client/server mismatch errors).
NOTES.md documents when to choose TanStack Query vs an RSC server fetch vs 'use cache', with concrete criteria.

The c14 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; the QueryProvider is local to this challenge and the root layout is not edited; data is read via local _lib without editing lib/data.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
